payload.body_they: {{Name}} is quick to see what an idea, opportunity, or experience could grow into. That sense of possibility can take them places excessive caution would never reach, because they are often willing to enter the experience and learn from it. The complication is seeing value in several directions while still having one life to fit them into. Not every exciting possibility deserves a yes. What it adds and what it requires both matter.
